mapper.sql: FROM dev_app a LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.id = a.dept_id AND d.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = a.owner_id AND u.is_deleted = 0

a.id AS id, a.code AS code, a.`name` AS name, a.dept_id AS deptId, d.`name` AS deptName, a.owner_id AS ownerId, u.nickname AS ownerName, a.core_link AS coreLink, a.repo_type AS repoType, a.repo_url AS repoUrl, a.repo_branch AS repoBranch, a.repo_commit_id AS repoCommitId, a.`status` AS status, a.description AS description, a.create_time AS createTime
